history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person with dark, tousled hair and glasses with thick black frames is looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. They are wearing a black t-shirt with a red and white graphic logo on the left chest, featuring some text that is partially obscured but appears to have Japanese characters and the words "KING OF THE ROAD". A silver chain with a cross pendant rests on the t-shirt. The background is dimly lit and appears to be a bedroom. To the left, there's a hint of a wooden table or chair, and on the wall behind, two framed pictures are visible. The overall lighting is soft and moody, with a slightly grainy, low-light aesthetic, giving the image a casual, candid feel. The color palette is dominated by dark tones, with the red logo providing a subtle pop of color. The mood is relaxed and intimate.
